name: addonry
description: Manual-only tri-client plugin for autonomous end-to-end Chrome extension development.

interface.shortDescription: Build personal Chrome extensions end to end
interface.longDescription: Turns an explicit extension request into a scoped Manifest V3 project, tested in real Chrome, verified with Chrome DevTools, and installed for personal use when possible.

skillInstructions: Addonry is manual-only. Use its workflow and addonry-chrome-devtools MCP tools only after the user explicitly runs the provider's create-chrome-extension skill or command, or explicitly names Addonry for Chrome extension creation.

args: $roots = @($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:PLUGIN_ROOT, (Get-Location).Path) | Where-Object { $_ }; $root = $roots | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_ 'scripts/start-chrome-devtools-mcp.ps1') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $root) { throw 'Addonry plugin root not found.' }; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/start-chrome-devtools-mcp.ps1')
